Dear Sirs, 
 
Sub:  
Intimation of Earnings Conference Call for Financial Performance of MMFSL for Q2 FY27 – Regulation 
30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing 
Regulations”)  
 
We hereby inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services 
Limited ("the Company /MMFSL") is scheduled to be held on Wednesday, 21st October 2026.  
 
Consequent to the above and in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III, Part A, Para A (15) of the 
Listing Regulations and SEBI Master Circular dated 11th July 2023 (updated as on 30th January 2026), and other 
applicable provisions of the Listing Regulations, we hereby inform you that the Earnings Conference Call 
(“Earnings Call”) of the Company for Q2 FY27 (quarter ended 30th September 2026) has been scheduled as under:
